reviewStatus: Drafted from verified sources; pending independent clinician review before clinical release.
commonErrors: Mixing the 5 m and 10 m wording versions.
name: GBS Disability Scale (Hughes)

version.label: GBS disability scale (Hughes 1978) as used in EGOS (van Koningsveld 2007)
version.detail: Grades 0–6. Wording of grades 2–3 differs slightly between versions (5 m vs 10 m); the EGOS wording is used.

purpose: Grades functional disability in Guillain-Barré syndrome.

options.label: 1: Minor symptoms and capable of running
2: Able to walk 10 m or more without assistance but unable to run
3: Able to walk 10 m across an open space with help
5: Requiring assisted ventilation for at least part of the day

resultStates.label: Healthy state
resultStates.summary: No disability measured by the scale at this assessment.
resultStates.detail: Fatigue, pain and sensory symptoms are not captured.

resultStates.label: Grade {total}: unable to walk independently
resultStates.summary: Unable to walk 10 m without help.

resultStates.label: Grade 5: ventilated
resultStates.summary: Requires assisted ventilation for at least part of the day.

clinicalContext.text: The standard functional outcome in GBS trials; grade 3 or more defines inability to walk independently.

clinicalInsights.text: The grade at 2 weeks after admission feeds the EGOS prognostic score.

limitations: Insensitive to upper limb, sensory and autonomic involvement.

confounders.effect: Raise the grade independent of GBS.

guideSections.what: Seven grades from healthy (0) to dead (6).
guideSections.whenToUse: Serial assessment in GBS and trial outcomes.
guideSections.howToPerform: Assess walking, running and ventilation needs; choose the grade.
guideSections.clinicalContext: Used with MRC sum score and EGOS.

sources.citation: Hughes RAC, Newsom-Davis JM, Perkin GD, Pierce JM. Controlled trial of prednisolone in acute polyneuropathy. Lancet. 1978;2(8093):750-753.
van Koningsveld R, Steyerberg EW, Hughes RAC, Swan AV, van Doorn PA, Jacobs BC. A clinical prognostic scoring system for Guillain-Barré syndrome. Lancet Neurol. 2007;6(7):589-594.
